note: Hand-maintained, on purpose and for now. The roadmap's workstream 4 asks whether an LLM with no session context can port an app from a pack folder alone, and the only honest way to answer that is to run one and write down what happened. Nothing automates it yet, so this file is a record somebody typed, and tools/ledger.ts reads it into a cell's blind mark rather than pretending to have computed it. Every entry names what the agent was given, because "ported blind" means nothing without that list. When this becomes a job, the job writes this file and this note goes away.

runs.given: the pack folder, the app bundle, and docs/convention/ - no session context and no sibling port to copy from
runs.how: bun run verify-bundle went green on the first run, with no correction from a person
